text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't even make the board... Pathetic of me...
Everyone was so strong, I couldn't hold a candle to them...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Still... this frustration, this pain...
it's all gonna become fuel for me!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Uwooh! I'll definitely get my revenge!
choice_data_list: ...Do you really think you can win with that?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! Time for today's review session right away!
Got to strike while the iron is hot!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
If I join forces with Trainer,
I should be able to catch up to my rivals...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, things can't go on like this.
But—I have no intention of letting this just end with words.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'll do everything I can with all my might
and just charge recklessly forward!!
